global.institution: Oceanic Platform of the Canary Islands

precise_latitude.sdn_parameter_name: Latitude north relative to WGS84 by unspecified GPS system

precise_longitude.sdn_parameter_name: Longitude east relative to WGS84 by unspecified GPS system

depth.sdn_parameter_name: Depth (spatial coordinate) relative to water surface in the water body

sensor_id.long_name: identifier of the sensor that took the measurement

platform_id.long_name: identifier of the platform that took the measurement

ATMS.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
ATMS.sdn_parameter_name: Pressure (measured variable) exerted by the atmosphere by unknown instrument and correction to sea level

AIRT.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id

ATMP.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
ATMP.sdn_parameter_name: Pressure (measured variable) exerted by the atmosphere

DRYT.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
DRYT.sdn_parameter_name: Temperature of the atmosphere by dry bulb thermometer

RELH.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
RELH.sdn_parameter_name: Relative humidity of the atmosphere by humidity sensor

WDIR.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
WDIR.long_name: Wind from direction relative true north
WDIR.sdn_parameter_name: Direction (from) of wind relative to True North {wind direction} in the atmosphere

WSPD.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
WSPD.sdn_parameter_name: Speed of wind {wind speed} in the atmosphere

LGH4.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
LGH4.sdn_parameter_name: Downwelling vector irradiance as photons of electromagnetic radiation (PAR wavelengths) in the atmosphere by cosine-collector radiometer
LGH4.sdn_uom_name: Micromoles per square metre per second

TEMP.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
TEMP.sdn_parameter_name: Temperature of the water body by CTD or STD

CNDC.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
CNDC.sdn_parameter_name: Electrical conductivity of the water body by CTD

PSAL.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
PSAL.sdn_parameter_name: Practical salinity of the water body by CTD and computation using UNESCO 1983 algorithm

CPHL.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
CPHL.long_name: The amount (mass or quantity of matter) of the pigment chlorophyll-a per amount (volume or mass) of a body of water
CPHL.sdn_parameter_name: Concentration of chlorophyll-a {chl-a CAS 479-61-8} per unit volume of the water body [particulate >unknown phase] by in-situ chlorophyll fluorometer and manufacturer's calibration applied

DOXY.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
DOXY.long_name: The amount (volume, mass or quantity of matter) of dissolved oxygen per amount (volume or mass) of a body of water
DOXY.sdn_parameter_name: Concentration of oxygen {O2 CAS 7782-44-7} per unit volume of the water body [dissolved plus reactive particulate phase]

DOXY_TEMP.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
DOXY_TEMP.long_name: temperature of sensor for oxygen in sea water

PCO2.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
PCO2.long_name: surface partial pressure of carbon dioxide in sea water
PCO2.sdn_parameter_name: Partial pressure of carbon dioxide {CO2 CAS 124-38-9} {pCO2} in the water body

PHPH.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
PHPH.sdn_parameter_name: pH (total scale) {pH[T]} of the water body

TUR4.coordinates: time latitude longitude depth sensor_id platform_id
TUR4.long_name: Turbidity of water in the water body
TUR4.sdn_parameter_name: Turbidity of water in the water body
